approvers: Main contractor or developer via the subcontract package
reason: We don't buy this today and the main contractor decides what protection we provide. At about €19 per m² against film and tape for well under €1 per m², I'd never pay it out of my own margin. And a 50% deposit doesn't suit how we run cash.
objection: €19 per m² for a coating I'd have to pay for myself, with a deposit up front, when we pay suppliers at 60 to 90 days and film and tape does the job for pennies.
instead: Cheap protection film and tape, bought from the local hardware or builders' merchant, as the subcontract package specifies.
would_change_my_mind: The developer or main contractor writing it into the spec and paying for it, on 60-day terms with no deposit.
